description: This bar chart illustrates the ratio values for three language models – Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT – across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball” in that order, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For the “Movies” category, Llama3 has a blue bar reaching approximately 89%, Qwen2 has a red-brown bar reaching approximately 84%, and ChatGPT has a yellow bar reaching approximately 73%. In the “Songs” category, Llama3 has a blue bar reaching approximately 82%, Qwen2 has a red-brown bar reaching approximately 88%, and ChatGPT has a yellow bar reaching approximately 64%. Finally, for “Basketball”, Llama3 has a blue bar reaching approximately 68%, Qwen2 has a red-brown bar reaching approximately 57%, and ChatGPT has a yellow bar reaching approximately 62%. The bars are grouped by category, with each model represented by a different color within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
